# Run brief: a count in the saved-locations list

## Goal
- `--list` in `workflows/weather/scripts/run.py` shows how many locations are saved, in the heading above the list.

## Constraints
- Standard library only.
- UK English, with no em or en dashes and no smart quotes.

## Out of scope
- Every other part of the weather report.

## Acceptance checks
- python -m py_compile workflows/weather/scripts/run.py

## Edit paths
- workflows/weather/scripts/ | Measure: git ls-files workflows/weather/scripts/

## Open questions
None

## Source
- `workflows/weather/scripts/run.py`
